high_level_goal.name: Enable rapid variant annotation for research purposes
high_level_goal.description: Provide researchers with fast access to comprehensive variant annotations from multiple genomic and clinical databases to accelerate discovery and understanding of genetic variants.

low_level_goals.name: Query variant annotations from multiple genomic databases
low_level_goals.description: Allow the researcher to submit a variant identifier and retrieve aggregated annotations from public genomic databases such as ClinVar, dbSNP, and gnomAD.
